subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for `https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/252`, or replace/adopt it with a narrow target-repository fix for the session-recap stripping gap?
rationale: The bug boundary and fix shape are clear, but the only open closing PR is outside the target repository, conflicting, and not maintainer-modifiable, so automation should not silently open a competing repair without maintainer intent.

options.title: Replace the uneditable PR
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repository PR, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after a viable replacement exists.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the open fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase it into a maintainer-editable, clean branch.

options.title: Wait without action
options.body: Leave the issue and fork PR open while accepting that the source-reproducible leak remains unresolved for now.

recommendation.title: Replace the uneditable PR
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repository PR, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after a viable replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the TUI leading-only stripping path and are the strongest history-backed routing candidate for the UI/TUI fix ownership choice.
